Chapter 663: Chapter 7 Tuoba Ancient God (5000 Words, Please Subscribe)_2

Chapter 663: Chapter 7 Tuoba Ancient God (5000 words, please subscribe)_2

The other party could instantly take away Fang Qing’s Spirit Will.

“Ancient God?”

“Is it the Ancient God of the Evolution Path?”

The white-bearded old man’s face turned somewhat pale, as human civilization suppressed the spread of the Ancient Gods’ Evolution Paths.

It was because any Evolver cultivating the Ancient Gods’ Evolution Paths could possibly become a ‘vessel’ for the respective Ancient God.

Or be controlled by them.

...

But under normal circumstances, the Ancient Gods would not take any interest in the lives cultivating their Evolution Paths.

Because they disdain it.

Beings that could be called Ancient Gods were all special life forms, and they were almost uniquely special.

Such special life forms were extremely proud, and they spread their own Evolution Paths in order to make the Ultimate Leap, to become Supreme Beings.

Before completing the Ultimate Leap, would they act against those propagating it?

While human civilization suppressed various Ancient Gods’ Evolution Paths, it didn’t completely suppress them; it also had designs on the Ancient Gods themselves.

If an Ancient God failed in its leap to the Ultimate, it would die completely, and at that time, the lives cultivating the corresponding Evolution Path could aspire to inherit everything from that Ancient God.

…

“Don’t panic yet.”

“I’ll go and make some inquiries.”

Lin Yuan glanced at the white-bearded old man and spoke.

“Yes,” the white-bearded old man was anxious inside, but he knew that hurrying was useless.

After the white-bearded old man disappeared, Lin Yuan fell into deep thought.

“The Ancient Gods’ Evolution Path that Fang Qing is cultivating…” Lin Yuan immediately used his authority and started searching.

As an Eighth Rank Citizen and a Grand Evolver Scholar, in the whole of human civilization, apart from those top secrets, there was little that Lin Yuan could not find.

Very soon.

Lin Yuan understood the details of the Ancient Gods’ Evolution Path that Fang Qing was cultivating.

“This Evolution Path of the Ancient Gods, it comes from ‘Tuoba Ancient God’?” Lin Yuan stroked his chin.

Based on his own perception of Fang Qing’s causal line, he confirmed that the area where the Spirit Will was located was indeed the territory of Tuoba Ancient God.

“It must have been Tuoba Ancient God’s doing.”

Lin Yuan thought silently to himself.

“But what significance does a mere Sixth Rank Life’s Spirit Will have for an existence like Tuoba Ancient God?” Lin Yuan was puzzled inside.

Tuoba Ancient God, a mysteriously old special life form, had long mastered the Rule of Time, and had reached the end in the Fusion of Time and Space.

It could be said that even among the multitude of Ancient Gods, Tuoba Ancient God was not weak.

For such a being, a Sixth Rank Life was almost as insignificant as a speck of dust; to specifically take away Fang Qing’s Spirit Will?

Lin Yuan could think of no reason at the moment.

“First, see if Tuoba Ancient God can be contacted peacefully.” Lin Yuan felt this matter could be resolved peacefully.

So far, there had been no conflicts or grievances between Tuoba Ancient God and human civilization, and if Lin Yuan was willing to pay some price, there was a great chance he could retrieve Fang Qing’s Spirit Will from Tuoba Ancient God.

With that thought.

Lin Yuan immediately started to contact several friends.

At Lin Yi’s wedding, Lin Yuan had met a large number of Tenth Rank Evolvers.

As the strongest genius in human civilization’s history, many powerful individuals were willing to favor Lin Yuan.

…

“What?”

“The Galaxy Master wants to contact Tuoba Ancient God?”

“This Ancient God’s temper is said to be quite bad.”

“I don’t know Tuoba Ancient God, but I know other Ancient Gods; there should be contact between Ancient Gods…”

…

As part of the peak clans in the Cosmic Starry Skies, human civilization’s influence was great, and many of the Tenth Rank Evolvers had connections, quickly bringing results to Lin Yuan.

Within his personal space.

A chubby figure appeared.

“Galaxy Master.”

The tone of this chubby figure was rather complex.

“Is it you?”

Lin Yuan was somewhat stunned.

This chubby figure was Maduo Traveler from the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Maduo Traveler, also a special life form, was the offspring of an Ancient God deep within the Cosmic Starry Skies.

Human civilization’s virtual world network, typically, was not open to different species.

But as a High-Rank Evolver, he could briefly apply for permission to establish a temporary virtual network, allowing different species to connect.

But during the connection period, the actions of the different species would be monitored and recorded.

“My ancestor knows Tuoba Ancient God; he said he can help introduce you.” Maduo Traveler said outright.

Maduo Traveler hadn’t acted promptly in matters of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, and his Ancient God Ancestor had deeply regretted it.

What a good opportunity it had been.

And it was wasted like that.

Now, upon hearing that the Galaxy Master wanted to contact Tuoba Ancient God.

Maduo Traveler’s Ancient God Ancestor immediately knew the chance had come again.

Although he didn’t know for what matter Lin Yuan wanted to contact Tuoba Ancient God.

But such an open request must be highly valued.

If he could help the Galaxy Master at this time.

It might not be called a favor, but at least it could make the Galaxy Master think highly of him.

After all, isn’t acquaintance accumulated bit by bit?

“I see.”

Lin Yuan nodded, “Then thanks to Sizhong Ancient God.”

Maduo Traveler’s Ancient God Ancestor was known as Sizhong Ancient God and was famed for his extensive connections, so knowing Tuoba Ancient God was not surprising.

“However, my ancestor said that Tuoba Ancient God has a bad temper; before meeting Tuoba Ancient God again, my ancestor wants to meet you, Galaxy Master,” Maduo Traveler said.

“No problem,” Lin Yuan nodded.

The meeting would definitely take place in a temporarily built virtual world, so Lin Yuan’s safety need not be worried about.

Very soon.

Another chubby figure appeared.

In comparison with Maduo Traveler, this chubby figure exerted much more pressure on Lin Yuan.
